citations.title: Israel Government Open Data Portal — Civil Defence and Shelter Datasets
citations.excerpt: Israel's official open-data portal (data.gov.il) publishes and maintains a catalog of civil-defence and public-shelter datasets across municipalities, updated by local authorities as part of ongoing home-front readiness reporting infrastructure operated by the national government.

citations.title: Jerusalem Post Reviews Civil-Defence Data Transparency Efforts
citations.excerpt: The Jerusalem Post reports that Israel's open civil-defence data initiative continues to expand, with municipalities across the country contributing updated shelter and preparedness datasets to the national open-data portal for public transparency.

dailyBrief.title: Israel's Open Civil-Defence Data Initiative Continues Expansion, Jerusalem Post Reports
dailyBrief.summary: Israel's national open-data portal continues publishing civil-defence and shelter datasets, with Jerusalem Post reporting ongoing transparency efforts by municipalities nationwide.

claims.title: Government open-data portal maintains civil-defence datasets
claims.text: Israel's official open-data portal publishes and maintains civil-defence and public-shelter datasets contributed by municipalities as part of national home-front readiness infrastructure.

citationLinks.rationale: The official government portal directly publishes and describes these datasets.

passages.text: Israel's open-data portal continues to serve as the national repository for civil-defence and shelter datasets, with municipalities contributing updated records as part of ongoing home-front readiness reporting.
Jerusalem Post reporting corroborates that the transparency initiative around civil-defence data has continued expanding, with additional municipalities contributing datasets this year.
The government's open-data portal is expected to continue expanding its civil-defence dataset coverage as more municipalities participate in the national transparency initiative.

articles.title: Municipalities Add Shelter Datasets to Israel's National Open-Data Portal
articles.summary: Local authorities are contributing updated shelter and preparedness records to the national open-data portal, which the Jerusalem Post reports is continuing to expand.

claims.title: Municipalities contribute shelter datasets to the national portal
claims.text: Municipalities across Israel contribute updated shelter and preparedness datasets to the national open-data portal as part of home-front readiness reporting.

citationLinks.rationale: The official portal publishes the datasets and names the contributing local authorities.
Independent reporting describes the same municipal contributions to the portal.

passages.text: Israel's official open-data portal catalogues civil-defence and public-shelter datasets that local authorities update as part of ongoing home-front readiness reporting operated by the national government.

Jerusalem Post reporting describes the same initiative continuing to expand, with municipalities across the country contributing updated shelter and preparedness datasets to the national portal for public transparency.

articles.title: Claim That Israel Conceals Shelter Locations From the Public
articles.summary: This organisation's own analysis of a circulating claim that shelter locations are withheld from the public.

claims.title: The concealment claim is unsupported by the public record
claims.text: The circulating claim that shelter locations are deliberately withheld from the public is not supported by any material reviewed for this record.
claims.uncertainty: No independent verification of the claim's origin was available.

passages.text: The circulating claim asserts that shelter locations are deliberately withheld from residents, and offers no dataset, document or named authority in support of that assertion.
This record is our own assessment rather than a report of documented fact, and it cites no source: readers should weigh it as analysis, and the claim it answers is stated in full above.

narrativeWatch.exactClaim: Israel deliberately conceals the locations of public shelters from residents.
knownUnknowns: The original source of the allegation has not been identified.
